in_sanskrit.name: Nibas
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the House
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nibas एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nibas is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nivasa' which means 'dwelling' or 'house'. In Hindu mythology, Nibas is the name of a god associated with the home and hospitality. He is believed to bring peace, prosperity, and happiness to the household.
